name: Weak guesstimate: Instagram photos with no scoping, unrealistic 90% posting rate, arithmetic slip, single number

messages.text: Estimate how many photos are uploaded to Instagram every day.
Instagram has about 2 billion users. Most people use it every day, so I will say 90 percent post every day. And each person posts maybe 5 photos.
Is 90 percent of users posting every day realistic?
I think so, everyone I know is always on Instagram and posting stories and stuff. So 2 billion times 0.9 times 5, that is about 90 billion photos a day.
Can you walk me through that multiplication again?
Yeah, 2 billion times 0.9 is like 1.8 billion, times 5, so it is around 90 billion.
Does your 5 photos include Stories, carousels, and DMs, or just feed posts?
All of it I guess, I will just include them in the 5. It is probably more for some people and less for others.
How would you check whether 90 billion is in the right range?
I am not sure there is a way to check it without the real data. I will go with 90 billion photos a day.
